main.description: Service to the profession: peer review, editorial roles, programme committees, society office, organising. CRITICAL PRIVACY CONSTRAINT: for peer review, this schema records the VENUE and an aggregate COUNT only. There is deliberately no field for which manuscripts were reviewed, and none must ever be added -- reviewer anonymity is constitutive of the institution, and a public record identifying reviewed manuscripts would break it irreversibly for authors who never consented.

type.description: 'academyMember' covers 日本学術会議 連携会員/会員 and equivalent national academy appointments; 'governmentCommittee' covers 審議会・委員会 appointments. Both are 委員歴 in researchmap, which is a separate CV section from peer review and editorial work -- a dossier separates them via sectionSpec.includeTypes rather than via separate record types.

venue.description: Journal, conference, society, or funding body as it should be printed.

roleTitle.description: Free-text title for roles the enum cannot capture, e.g. '理事', 'Treasurer', 'Diversity Chair'.

reviewCount.description: Number of manuscripts reviewed for this venue in this period. AGGREGATE ONLY. Never record which manuscripts.

verificationUrl.description: Link to an external recognition record (ORCID peer-review record, Web of Science Reviewer Recognition). These systems already publish counts without identifying manuscripts, so citing them adds credibility at no privacy cost.
